title: Preserve request semantics when the fast path fails
description: Inject an upstream timeout, hot-cache expiry, or forged forwarding header. Change one control at a time and observe the business consequence, not only the proxy status code.

scenarios.label: The upstream times out after receiving the request
scenarios.detail: NGINX knows the response did not arrive in time, but the application's durable outcome may be unknown.

scenarios.label: A hot cache entry expires under load
scenarios.detail: Two hundred callers request the same representation while the origin is slow.

scenarios.label: A client supplies a forged forwarding header
scenarios.detail: Rate limits and audit policy depend on the client address observed at the trusted edge.
